Class GameWebSocketController

java.lang.Object
com.barbu.api.game.GameWebSocketController
@Controller public class GameWebSocketController extends Object
STOMP WebSocket controller for real-time game events.

Creating, joining and leaving a game are handled by GameRestController.

    • handleStart

      @MessageMapping("/games/{gameId}/lobby/start") public void handleStart(@DestinationVariable UUID gameId, Principal principal)
      Fills empty seats with bots and broadcasts the lobby. Then starts the game and broadcasts the game state.
